purpose: Diagnose and repair the uniformly grey instanced crowd (AMikdashCrowdField): read-only dump of the HISM material assignments, NumCustomDataFloats and per-instance custom data from the main map; then a guarded material fix with a muted multi-hue garment palette under /Game/MikdashV3/MaterialReview/CrowdFieldV1/.

existingRobeLerp.why: The authored V1 palette: five lerp steps between two near-neutral colours. Even with the channel intact this is five shades of grey.

objSlotOrder.source: SourceAssets/runtime-review/crowd-field/CrowdFigureV1/SM_CrowdFigure_P*.obj, g/usemtl order, identical for all six poses

fix.readWhy: PerInstanceCustomData is read in the vertex stage and carried to the pixel stage by a VertexInterpolator, the same route this project's tree-crown ISM materials use and have rendered with (Scripts/import_instances_ue58.py). It removes any dependence on pixel-stage instance payload access.
fix.sentinelWhy: If the custom data channel is unavailable to the shader every figure falls to palette entry 6 (traveller-dust): acceptable to look at, and a recognisable signature that is not the V1 grey.

brightness.why: Per-figure brightness from custom data 0 so two figures in the same garment are not identical.

garmentPalette.name: ochre-muted
garmentPalette.source: authored: between mantle-saffron and traveller-dust, desaturated

garmentPalette.name: linen-bleached
garmentPalette.source: release_people_v3.spec.json garments.variants.linen-bleached; the white share (1 of 8 = 12.5%)

fix.applyAs: per-slot override materials on the six CrowdPose HISM components of RELEASE_CrowdField (map change), not on the mesh assets; ConfigureComponents() keeps overrides because SetStaticMesh() early-outs on an unchanged mesh and CrowdMaterialOverride stays unset.
limitations: White is a global 12.5 percent share; zone-aware white (courts only) needs the C++ GarmentIndex to know the zone, which is outside this fix.
No render is made by the commandlet; visual acceptance is a real-RHI capture by the coordinator.
The GPU bob (world position offset) is not carried by the new materials; the actor keeps its CPU bob (BobAmplitudeCm 3.5) as recorded by native-apply-20260908T135329649669Z.
